name: Jared Galloway
bio: I build machine learning models and the software that puts them to work on noisy, high-dimensional biological data. I hold a B.S. in Computer & Information Science and an M.S. in Biology, and have spent nine years developing methods in research groups at HHMI, Fred Hutch, and the University of Oregon.

I work across the whole modeling lifecycle: encoding data, fitting models in JAX, PyTorch, and TensorFlow, validating on simulated and experimental data, and shipping open-source packages that other labs use in their primary analyses.

My work includes [ReLERNN](https://github.com/kr-colab/ReLERNN), an RNN for recombination-rate estimation (180+ citations); [multidms](https://github.com/matsengrp/multidms), a JAX model of deep mutational scans; and [phippery](https://github.com/matsengrp/phippery), a PhIP-Seq data-processing suite, plus pipelines run at scale with Nextflow and Snakemake on HPC and AWS.
I left the Matsen Lab in August 2026 and am looking for my next role in applied machine learning. I explain technical results clearly to collaborators of every background.
